verdict.rationale: vLLM's docs explicitly list a broad quantization stack spanning very-low-bit (INT4, NVFP4, MXFP4) through 8-bit (INT8, FP8) formats, including GPTQ/AWQ/GGUF and compressed-tensors backends, which directly matches the power-user's memory-footprint story [vllm-docs-4][vllm-docs-22][vllm-docs-23][vllm-docs-30]. However, a hands-on community report specifically states 4-bit quantization 'doesn't appear to be supported' in vLLM, concretely contradicting the current low-bit quantization claims [vllm-comm-1]. missing for 10: recent independent benchmarks confirming INT4/8-bit quantization works end-to-end and resolution of the community report's discrepancy.
